Develop multi-agent systems and AI copilots that streamline campaign ideation, execution, and performance reporting.   Collaborate with Applied Scientists to develop machine learning-powered features, including audience optimization and incrementality measurement.   Build monitoring and alerting infrastructure to ensure high availability and reliability of marketing operations.   Contribute to system design, architecture decisions, and code reviews to improve software quality, scalability, and reliability. Preferred Qualifications     Experience developing AI-native systems.   Familiarity with agentic frameworks and Amazon Bedrock.
